items.title: Cross-site form skeleton
items.context: A cookie-authenticated reversible form action using controlled domains
items.intended_use: Model a browser-emittable request before adding synthetic fields
caveats: Replace the reserved target only with an authorized test origin; never auto-submit sensitive actions
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.

items.title: Origin control value
items.context: A raw comparison request plus a real controlled browser origin
items.intended_use: Check exact Origin validation using a reserved test origin
caveats: Repeater can spoof Origin but cannot prove browser exploitability
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.

items.title: Simple media-type control

caveats: Use a reversible synthetic action and confirm committed state
